dataset: Planck PR4 binned primordial bispectrum shape reconstruction
data_kind: Observation-derived measured shape and simulation-calibrated covariance with triangle-bin coordinates; not QSFI theory coefficients, templates, or fitted QSFI parameters.

reference.author: Oliver H. E. Philcox
reference.title: What Shape is the Inflationary Bispectrum?

license: MIT; full upstream copyright notice and permission text are included in LICENSE.
conversion: One-time container conversion of the four unmodified float64 arrays to JSON decimal numbers; all entries round-trip to the original IEEE754 float64 bytes. The native Mathematica workflow reads this JSON directly and does not invoke reference.

schema.data: Measured binned primordial bispectrum shape S_hat
schema.cov: Full covariance matrix of the measured shape

runtime_dependencies: Mathematica native JSON import only; the NPZ container and this conversion helper are not needed at runtime.
